idea-plugin.name: EWP Project Sync
idea-plugin.description:
Keep *.ewp project files (from IAR EWARM) correct and in sync with changes in CLion, by avoiding manual, error-prone changes in the xml

Features

  • Sort on Reformat: The file lists in the .ewp project file are sorted correctly, like EWARM does
  • Add New Files to ewp: When creating new source files in the IDE, you can choose to add them to the EWP project file too. The plugin tries to find the best file group based on existing files in the ewp project
  • Delete / Move / Rename Sync: When you delete, move, or rename source files in the IDE, matching entries in every .ewp that lists them are updated automatically (including group remapping on move and pruning empty groups on delete)
  • Clickable Paths: Ctrl/Cmd-click a $PROJ_DIR$ path inside an .ewp file to open the referenced source file
  • Work With Multiple ewp Files: The plugin detects all ewp files in the project tree and considers them when appropriate (e.g. when adding new files)
  • Browse groups and files in the EWP Explorer tool window

What this plugin is not

This plugin can NOT load ewp files as a project to compile them. You still need to load a project by the means supported by CLion (e.g. Cmake, compilation database)

Legal Notice

This is an unofficial plugin for .ewp files used with IAR Embedded Workbench for Arm (EWARM). This plugin is not affiliated with IAR Systems.
